suggestions: Protein target hit on 40/57 logged days — strong, consistent muscle-retention support. Keep it up.
Calories ran 10%+ over target on 23/57 days, mostly around restaurant meals and desserts — no single day is a problem, but the pattern is worth watching against the weight-loss goal.

Fat has averaged 93g/day vs the 65g target (143%) across all 57 logged days — it runs about equally high on restaurant and home-cooked days (olive oil, cheese, nuts show up everywhere), so it's a portion-size habit rather than something restaurants specifically drive.

Only ~16% of daily protein is eaten before noon on average — it's heavily back-loaded into lunch/dinner. Adding 20-30g to breakfast (eggs, yogurt, cheese) would spread muscle-protein-synthesis stimulus more evenly across the day and help with morning satiety.

Caffeine has been logged at/after the 16:00 cutoff 12 time(s) across the tracked period — your own baseline flags that cutoff as the sleep-friendly line, worth tightening even without a clean sleep-quality signal yet tying the two together.
Folate averaging 255 vs a ~400 target over the last 5 day(s) (64%) — tracked weekly, not daily (a slow-reserve nutrient) — add leafy greens, legumes on a lighter day to bring the average up.
Average logged sleep is 7.2h across 53 nights tracked — an established trend at this point, not a sample. 26/53 nights (49%) landed in the 7-9h target band.
8 ejaculation event(s) logged in the last 14 days — aiming for roughly every 1-2 days (8-14 over a 14-day span) tracks best with the sperm-quality research.

Weight is -1.10 kg vs. the 2026-06-27 baseline, 2.3 kg from the 76-78 kg target range — pace is steady but slower than the 0.4 kg/week goal; tightening portions on non-restaurant days would help most.
